questions.prompt: Which of these are fruits, to a botanist?
questions.fact: A fruit is the part that holds the seeds, which is why a tomato counts and a carrot does not.

questions.prompt: Which of these sports are played at the Summer Olympics?
questions.fact: Curling, bobsleigh and ski jumping all need ice or snow, so they belong to the Winter Games.

questions.prompt: How many strings does a standard guitar have?
questions.fact: Six. A bass guitar usually has four, and a ukulele has four as well.

questions.prompt: How deep can an emperor penguin dive, in metres?
questions.fact: Over 500 metres, and it can hold its breath for more than twenty minutes doing it.

questions.prompt: Which country gave the world the Taj Mahal?
questions.hint: It stands on the bank of the Yamuna river.
questions.fact: It was built as a tomb for the emperor's wife, and took about twenty years to finish.

questions.prompt: What does a Geiger counter measure?
questions.hint: The clicking sound is the giveaway.
questions.fact: Each click is one particle striking the tube, so a faster clicking means a stronger source.

questions.prompt: Invasion confirmed. Dock at Wikiplanet Station and pull up its satellite feed.
One more landing site. Find it and call the fleet in.
